summary: First-pass full-stack test of StartupInternships.in MVP. Backend: 44/44 pytest tests passing covering public, auth, internships, student/startup/institution/admin flows, role guards, match-score tiers, profile updates, notifications. Frontend: Landing page, login (all 4 roles via quick-fill), student/startup/admin/institution dashboards, kanban, post-internship form, admin verifications, logout all render correctly with no console errors. Found and FIXED one HIGH bug in backend (MongoDB collection truthy check on /auth/me caused 500 for every logged-in user).
action_items: OPTIONAL: Verify the kanban-column data-testid naming convention. Tests with names 'applied', 'under_review', 'shortlisted', 'interview_scheduled', 'offered', 'hired', 'rejected' found 6/7; one column name may differ slightly (likely 'interview' vs 'interview_scheduled'). Not blocking but should be standardized for E2E testability.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED in /app/backend/server.py _get_profile(): replaced `if not coll:` with `if coll is None:` since Motor/PyMongo collections raise NotImplementedError on truthiness check. This was causing GET /api/auth/me to throw 500 for every authenticated user (student/startup/institution/admin).
server.py is approaching the 700-line guideline — consider splitting into routers/ subpackage (auth, public, student, startup, institution, admin, notifications) before adding more features.

Landing-page public live-stats now show 16 startups / 24 listings due to TEST data created by tests. Consider filtering TEST_ records out of /api/public/stats OR adding a teardown to clean TEST data after tests. Currently no cleanup fixture is implemented.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (1-line bug fix: `if not coll` -> `if coll is None`)

Public /api/health, /api/public/stats, /api/public/internships, /api/public/institutions all 200 OK. /auth/me 500 bug FIXED (was MongoDB collection truthiness — server.py line ~93). All 4 roles login fine. Demo seed: 15 verified startups, 12 students, 10 institutions, 22 live listings (plus extras from tests). Frontend uses httpOnly cookies, axios withCredentials=true. Kanban testids confirmed for 6 of 7 statuses — verify interview/interview_scheduled naming. No mocked endpoints other than email (in-app notifications only per user choice).

rca_of_the_issue.bug: GET /api/auth/me returned 500 Internal Server Error for all authenticated users
rca_of_the_issue.rca: In /app/backend/server.py _get_profile(role, user), the code did `coll = {...}.get(role)` then `if not coll: return None`. Motor AsyncIOMotorCollection (like PyMongo Collection) raises NotImplementedError when evaluated for truth value to prevent ambiguity. Stack trace: 'Collection objects do not implement truth value testing or bool(). Please compare with None instead: collection is not None'.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) Login as any role (cookies set). 2) GET /api/auth/me → 500.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Changed `if not coll:` to `if coll is None:`. Verified via re-running test_auth_me_authenticated → PASS.
